content: Bilingual PT-BR/EN resumes for the Brazilian tech market: match the resume language to the posting language (English for multinationals, Portuguese currículo for local), maintain separate single-language versions rather than one mixed document so keyword matching works in whichever language the ATS expects, and list language proficiency explicitly as a skill. Brazilian curriculo convention is clean and chronological. MEDIUM confidence (search results, latojobs, edugradus, resume-example sources).
